plans.name: Gio Health Services Inc
plans.address: 6323 Georgia Avenue NW, Suite 360, Washington, DC 20011
plans.grade_basis: 0.7 mi; she uses Metro or Metrobus.
steps: Book the appointment with the provider first, so you have a date and time for the ride.
To book a ride, call AmeriHealth Caritas DC at 1-800-315-3485 at least 48 hours ahead (weekends and holidays do not count). No rides on Sundays or holidays.
If she prefers a loaded SmarTrip card, call the same number 3-5 business days ahead.
For the Metrobus half-price discount, enroll in WMATA Metro Lift at wmata.com/metrolift or in person at L'Enfant, Silver Spring or Rosslyn.
To enroll, bring a SmarTrip card for each person, her active SNAP EBT card, the SNAP benefits summary for the household, government photo ID, and a phone number.
plans.tell_client: This clinic is about 0.7 miles away, and the trip is an estimate of one bus ride. We can call for a ride at least 48 hours before the visit, not counting weekends and holidays.

questions.text: She uses the bus with help. Who can ride with her, or can the ride service help her board?
Can her young child ride along, and is there a car seat or childcare at the visit?
Once the appointment is set, book the ride with AmeriHealth Caritas DC rides (Medicaid managed care) early enough (see booking notes).
